title: Missing Buttons and Features
summary: Reviews in this topic consistently criticize the G60 for missing physical buttons, omitted convenience equipment, and features that feel inadequate for the vehicle's price and brand expectations.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on missing straightforward buttons, absent convenience items such as a passenger charging point or rear wiper, and broader complaints that the vehicle lacks expected features, materials, and design character.

limitations: The sample contains only negative fragments, so there are no contrasting examples from other sentiment groups.
This topic mixes several distinct complaints, including missing buttons, missing equipment, materials, performance and quietness, and exterior design character.
